HISD Sidebar Navigation

Grouped sidebar navigation built entirely from HISD semantic tokens. The active link uses --color-brand text with a 3 px border-inline-start and aria-current="page"; hover raises the surface to --color-surface-raised. Logical properties mean the rail mirrors correctly in RTL. Arrow Up/Down, Home, and End move roving focus per the WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices Guide.

Copy-paste snippet

<nav class="hisd-sidebar" aria-label="School portal">
  <div class="hisd-sidebar__group">
    <h3 class="hisd-sidebar__heading" id="grp-overview">Overview</h3>
    <ul class="hisd-sidebar__list" aria-labelledby="grp-overview">
      <li class="hisd-sidebar__item">
        <a class="hisd-sidebar__link" href="/dashboard" aria-current="page">
          <svg class="hisd-sidebar__icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">
            <path fill="currentColor" d="M12 3 3 10v11h6v-6h6v6h6V10z"/>
          </svg>
          <span class="hisd-sidebar__label">Dashboard</span>
        </a>
      </li>
      <li class="hisd-sidebar__item">
        <a class="hisd-sidebar__link" href="/announcements">
          <span class="hisd-sidebar__label">Announcements</span>
          <span class="hisd-sidebar__badge">3</span>
        </a>
      </li>
    </ul>
  </div>
</nav>
